provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: Title says 'Case B (H/d=0.0.0378)' (L102) though the directory is case_A, and the H/d value contains a doubled decimal ('0.0.0378'); model station elevations are plotted in their native units against cm-converted reference data with no *100 conversion (L25-33 is a no-op loop) -- unit consistency cannot be confirmed here.
audit_member_text: Every assignment in the second loop L26-L32 assigns each element to itself, so this loop has no effect.
The file resides under case_A and is named BM5_A_Plotter, but the active title at L102 says Case B; its H/d text also contains the anomalous literal 0.0.0378.

base_member_text: Model time is divided by 10 before shifting (L15-21) -- implies the station files' time column is in 0.1-s units for this case; not documented in the file.
g-series are rescaled only over their first 600 samples (L35) while plotted in full against t from A.mat; if the series are longer than 600 the tail remains in meters.
Gauge numbering n4..n10 vs station files sta_0001..sta_0007 mapping and the physical gauges 4-10 layout come from the benchmark definition, external to this file.

audit_member_text: Both loops at L14-L33 use length(n4) while indexing n5 through n10; shorter arrays fail and longer arrays retain unshifted or untouched tail rows.
The conversion loop at L35-L43 unconditionally accesses elements 1..600 of all g4..g10 arrays imported at L2; no length check prevents out-of-range access.

Each plot pairs imported time t with a g series at L69,L74,L79,L84,L89,L94,L99 without checking equal lengths; station and reference inputs likewise receive no column-count checks before two-column indexing.
Offsets are actively applied to n4/g4 through n9/g9 at L47-L63, while the analogous n10/g10 offsets are commented at L65-L66; whether the seventh trace is intentionally unshifted is not stated.
